en.html: One glance below—and my heart forgot its work. Which village was it? I did not know. Half swallowed by the dark, people were writhing. This was what the end of the world looked like. Screams. Trampling. Blood-mist. Steel and fire. Had Rokuhara's war with the occupation forces spread here? Or had that 'god' coming down increased the Mental Pestilence nearby, driving them toward that terrible madness? Which of the two, who could say? One thing only was certain. This horror was happening. By some chance, a little gap stood open inside the riot. A child was there. Miraculously, the child was alive this instant. In the next instant, the child would probably be dead. In the one after that, probably unrecognizable. The child looked up. A line of joy brightened that face. The child had seen me. In the warrior flying across the sky, the child had seen help coming. The child was right. I could save that child. Land quickly. Pick the child up while there was still life. No difficulty in doing that. The difficulty was me deciding to do it. Save the child,◆ become entangled in the chaos,◆ lose this once-in-a-lifetime chance to sever the source of disaster— If I could take that decision, then yes. I could save the child.
en.text:
One glance below—and my heart forgot its work.

Which village was it? I did not know.
Half swallowed by the dark, people were writhing.

This was what the end of the world looked like.


Screams.
Trampling.
Blood-mist.
Steel and fire.

Had Rokuhara's war with the occupation forces spread here?
Or had that 'god' coming down increased the Mental Pestilence nearby, driving them toward that terrible madness?

Which of the two, who could say?
One thing only was certain. This horror was happening.


By some chance, a little gap stood open inside the riot.
A child was there.

Miraculously, the child was alive this instant.

In the next instant, the child would probably be dead.
In the one after that, probably unrecognizable.

The child looked up.

A line of joy brightened that face.

The child had seen me.

In the warrior flying across the sky, the child had seen help coming.

The child was right.

I could save that child.

Land quickly. Pick the child up while there was still life. No difficulty in doing that.

The difficulty was me deciding to do it.

Save the child,◆
become entangled in the chaos,◆
lose this once-in-a-lifetime chance to sever the source of disaster—

If I could take that decision, then yes. I could save the child.

ja.html: ちらと下を見やったその一刹那、俺の心臓は鼓動を 止めた。 　あれは何処の村落であろうか。 　薄暗がりに半ば沈みつつ、人々が蠢うごめいている。 　末世の様相だ。 　叫喚。 　蹂躙。 　血煙。 　鉄火。 　六波羅と進駐軍の戦闘が波及したのか。 　それとも〝神〟の降下により付近の精神汚染濃度が 増して、あの恐るべき狂態へ陥ろうとしているのか。 　どちらとも知れない。 　惨劇が起きている、その一事実のみが確かだった。 　暴動の渦中、何の偶然か、ぽっかりと空いた隙間が ある。 　そこに、子供が一人いた。 　子供はこの瞬間を、奇跡的に生き延びている。 　だが次の瞬間には、死に見舞われるだろう。 　次の次の瞬間には、原形を保っていないだろう。 　子供は空を見上げた。 　その表情に一筋、輝くような喜びが差した。 　俺の姿を認めたのだ。 　天を駆ける騎影に、救いの手を見たのだ。 　子供は正しい。 　俺はあの子供を助ける事ができる。 　急着陸し、子供が生きているうちに拾い上げるのは 造作もない。 　俺の決断一つだ。 　子供を救い、◆ 　混乱に巻き込まれ、◆ 　災いの根源を断つ、この千載一遇の好機を逃す―― 　その決断さえ下せるなら、助けられる。
ja.text:
ちらと下を見やったその一刹那、俺の心臓は鼓動を
止めた。

　あれは何処の村落であろうか。
　薄暗がりに半ば沈みつつ、人々が蠢うごめいている。

　末世の様相だ。


　叫喚。
　蹂躙。
　血煙。
　鉄火。

　六波羅と進駐軍の戦闘が波及したのか。
　それとも〝神〟の降下により付近の精神汚染濃度が
増して、あの恐るべき狂態へ陥ろうとしているのか。

　どちらとも知れない。
　惨劇が起きている、その一事実のみが確かだった。


　暴動の渦中、何の偶然か、ぽっかりと空いた隙間が
ある。
　そこに、子供が一人いた。

　子供はこの瞬間を、奇跡的に生き延びている。

　だが次の瞬間には、死に見舞われるだろう。
　次の次の瞬間には、原形を保っていないだろう。

　子供は空を見上げた。

　その表情に一筋、輝くような喜びが差した。

　俺の姿を認めたのだ。

　天を駆ける騎影に、救いの手を見たのだ。

　子供は正しい。

　俺はあの子供を助ける事ができる。

　急着陸し、子供が生きているうちに拾い上げるのは
造作もない。

　俺の決断一つだ。

　子供を救い、◆
　混乱に巻き込まれ、◆
　災いの根源を断つ、この千載一遇の好機を逃す――

　その決断さえ下せるなら、助けられる。

I left the child there.

I decided it myself: this child, I would not save.

Call it by its proper name, then. Murder.

That one moment of miracle ended.

Savage iron came down on its little prey.

The child's despair—I saw it. There was no doubt.

The child's bitter cry against me—I heard it. There was no doubt.

Cut down, torn apart, trampled. That child had died horribly, and I accepted it as a fact. No doubt there either.

en.html:
The copies might be more trouble than the original itself.

Leave aside, for the moment, their ability to relay the contamination waves. Even without that, they had inherited their parent's tremendous mobility...
And the Zero-Zero Type's anti-dragoon sniper weapons.

Put those two together: trouble. I was being modest. Now multiply the trouble by one whole regiment.

Their advance was a mess. Tactics, if there were any, were keeping themselves well hidden. But sheer numbers let them cover the whole area. No opening to exploit, no space to escape into.

And would these gentlemen establish superiority and then politely ask for our surrender? Haan, keep dreaming. More likely every last one would open fire the moment we entered range.

So what to do?
A thick wall of shots all around us, every single one capable of killing. How, exactly, were we to deal with that—

They had brought the violence of numbers. We answered with speed that had no respect for common sense.

Again and again, the same result: they could not corner us. As we got used to the new manoeuvres, we were even finding a little breathing room.

But wait.

'We will not lose' was a very fine statement. Where in it had I explained how we would WIN?

For that, the difference in numbers still mattered. Bring them down one by one? When would that finish?

Arre, it would not. We would finish first. Run out of strength halfway through.

Break the encirclement and reach Fuji's summit... difficult, yes, but probably possible. Also a first-class way to put ourselves between God and an entire regiment. Our own trap, and we would kindly walk into it.

Somehow, draw the regiment away from Fuji.

...That seemed the best course.

Only the small matter of HOW remained. How to make this whole mob move where I wanted it—

ずつ余裕すら生まれつつあった。

　しかし――

　負けはしないにしても、どう打ち破ったものか。

　勝つとなると、やはりこの数の差は軽視し難い。
　一騎一騎墜としていてはいつ終わるか。

　いや、途中で力尽きる。

　包囲を破って富士山頂へ到達する……のは、難しく
とも不可能ではないだろう。
　が、それは〝神〟と複製連隊による挟撃という死地
を自ら招く愚策だ。

　何らかの方法で連隊を富士山から引き離す。

　……方針としては、これが最善と思われる。

　問題はその具体的手法。
　どうすれば敵集団を俺の希望通りに動かせるか――

Muramasa's present mobility was completely beyond normal warrior standards. Had I become careless because of that? Haan. Let us not start defending the indefensible.
